name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-configurable-list
title: Configurable List and Records
shortDescription: A read-only React web part for browsing configurable SharePoint list fields with sorting, search, and paging.
longDescription: This sample displays selected SharePoint list fields in a responsive table or card view.
It demonstrates explicit SharePoint REST select and expand queries, bounded paging, field-aware formatting, safe links, and keyboard-accessible sorting and selection.

references.name: Build your first SharePoint client-side web part
references.description: Client-side web parts run in the context of a SharePoint page and can use modern JavaScript web frameworks and libraries.
